resources.string: Show blocked users details
Show the name and avatar of blocked users in the blocked users list
Sync on push
Subscribe to room sync when a push is received
Exclude insecure devices when sending/receiving messages
Do not share keys with devices their owners have not verified. Breaks chatting with people on unverified devices. Restart the app after changing.
Print logs to logcat
Print logs to logcat in addition to log files. Restart the app after changing.
Select media quality per upload
Choose the quality of each photo or video before sending.
Threads
Show thread messages in their own timeline. Restart the app after changing.
Multiple accounts
Stay signed in to several accounts and switch between them in Settings.
Link a device by QR code
Sign in on another device by scanning a QR code from this one.
Black theme
Allow the pure black theme that saves battery on OLED screens.
Check the connection before fetching notifications
Only fetch events for notifications when the device is online.
Jump to unread messages
A button to jump to the first unread message and a count badge on the scroll-down button.
Slash commands
Parse /commands typed in the message field.
Thread list
A screen with all threads of a chat.
Preload chat history
Load older messages in the background. Restart the app after changing.
Unread counter
Show the number of unread messages in the chat list.
Albums
Select several photos or videos and send them as an album.
Ask to join
Allow creating chats that people can ask to join.
Message search
Index messages locally to search them. Only messages received while enabled are indexed.
